The seed routine installs a fixed active vendor API key. Anyone with repository access can authenticate to the order-status integration in environments initialized from this seed.

The application falls back to a repository-known secret key when APP_SECRET_KEY is absent. This key is used to hash reset tokens, session tokens, and API keys, weakening credential protection in misconfigured deployments.
